headline: Congress gives a bridge company permission to expand the Starr-Camargo international toll bridge near Rio Grande City, Texas.
what_it_does: This law allows the Starr-Camargo Bridge Company to expand its international toll bridge between Texas and Mexico near Rio Grande City. The expansion can include widening the existing bridge and building new spans next to it.

who_it_affects.how: The company gets federal permission to expand its existing toll bridge and add new spans beside it.

who_it_affects.group: People and businesses that cross the US-Mexico border near Rio Grande City, Texas
who_it_affects.how: The bridge they use may be enlarged under the permission this law grants.
